footnotes: Banks have no cost of sales; the flow chart shows revenue (net interest income + noninterest income) going to noninterest expense and the provision for credit losses, leaving pre-tax income. Other items, net are the gains and charges the income statement shows outside these lines (−$938K in 2025). Efficiency ratio = noninterest expense ÷ revenue (lower is better).
Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue (net interest income plus noninterest income) rose 10.0% to $90.0M in 2025. Net interest income rose 9.1% to $59.0M and noninterest income rose 11.8% to $31.0M; noninterest expense rose 3.4%, and the provision for credit losses was $0, versus $0.
Net income rose 21.3% to $19.8M, or $3.62 per diluted share, and the efficiency ratio was 70.2% versus 74.8%. Peoples Bancorp of North Carolina returned $5.2M through dividends.
